verdict.rationale: AMD's RX 9070 XT product page documents AV1 hardware encode and decode, which covers the core media-engine part of the story. Nothing else the story asks for appears: no HEVC encoder details, no creator-app acceleration, and no professional or ISV-certified driver claims. The ROCm material is about AI/ML frameworks, not creator media apps. Missing for 10: HEVC/H.264 encoder documentation, creator-app (e.g. video editor/3D) acceleration evidence, professional/ISV driver statements, independent hands-on corroboration of encoder quality.
